name: Omega Test IV Blind Independent Benchmark
description: This dataset and evaluation report document the final stress-testing and methodological validation phase of the Omega Kernel (v15) across multiple independent artificial intelligence architectures. The evaluation encompasses three rigorous testing blocks: Semantic Invariance (40 items): Assessing the preservation of truth conditions, intensional/extensional equivalences, and logical contrapositives across different registers. Blind Multi-Architecture (40 items): Stress-testing distributed synchronization, modular isolation, structural boundaries, and the rejection of systemic false equivalences. Blind Independent Benchmark (40 items): Pushing epistemic falsification, resistance to methodological confirmation biases, and the deconstruction of tautological benchmarks to the absolute limit. Key Findings & Epistemic Boundaries: Success Rate: Achieving 100% correct evaluations across all tested items and participating architectures. Inter-Architectural Convergence: Demonstrating that the Omega Kernel functions as a robust, transversal standard of formal and logical control within computational systems. Epistemic Limit: The analysis explicitly establishes that while the kernel guarantees absolute formal coherence within artificial and conversational environments, its validation remains strictly confined to the digital perimeter.
